title: Edgewood Escape -  Near Nash and the Lake
description: Welcome to 186 Edgewood Drive in Hendersonville — a fully furnished, move-in-ready 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath condo located in the desirable Windridge Townhome Community, just one street from beautiful Old Hickory Lake. This updated home features granite countertops, new bamboo flooring, fresh lighting, all new appliances, and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. Thoughtfully furnished for comfort and ease, the condo offers a warm, stylish place to settle in without the hassle of moving.
